FINAL IVX REGISTRATION + SIGN-IN ENTERPRISE CLOSEOUT
MEMBERS, INVESTORS, BUYERS, JV DEALS, TOKENIZED
FIX EVERY ROUTE, API, AUTH FLOW, DATABASE WRITE, SESSION, AND UI STATE
DEPLOY AND VERIFY WITH LIVE EVIDENCE

EXECUTE NOW.

DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER GENERAL AUDIT.
DO NOT CREATE SEPARATE BROKEN REGISTRATION FLOWS FOR EACH SCREEN.
DO NOT LEAVE “SUBMITTING…” OR “CONNECTING TO SERVER” RUNNING FOREVER.
DO NOT CLAIM PASS FROM UNIT TESTS ALONE.
DO NOT REQUEST CREDENTIALS UNTIL RUNTIME PROVES A STORED VARIABLE IS MISSING,
EXPIRED, REVOKED, INVALID, OR RETURNS HTTP 401/403.

==================================================
PRIMARY OBJECTIVE
==================================================

Build one canonical enterprise identity and registration pipeline for:

1. General members
2. Investors
3. Buyers
4. JV deal partners
5. Tokenized investors
6. Brokers
7. Agents
8. Land owners

Every signup surface must use the same backend orchestration and the same
canonical identity.

Required lifecycle:

FORM OPEN
→ CONFIG CHECK
→ HEALTH CHECK
→ CLIENT VALIDATION
→ REQUEST ID
→ SUBMIT
→ AUTH USER CREATION
→ PROFILE CREATION
→ MEMBER CREATION
→ ROLE ASSIGNMENT
→ ROLE-SPECIFIC RECORD
→ EMAIL/PHONE VERIFICATION STATE
→ SESSION CREATION
→ REDIRECT
→ METRICS
→ PROOF

No screen may directly create fragmented records independently.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — INVENTORY EVERY REGISTRATION SURFACE
==================================================

Find and document every signup and sign-in entry point:

- Landing page Create Free Account
- Investor review modal
- Invest Now flow
- General member registration
- Owner sign-in
- Member sign-in
- Investor sign-in
- Buyer sign-in
- JV partner sign-in
- Tokenized investor sign-in
- Broker sign-in
- Agent sign-in
- Mobile APK signup
- Mobile APK sign-in
- Web signup
- Web sign-in
- Password recovery
- Email confirmation
- Resend confirmation

For every surface return:

SURFACE:
ROUTE:
FILE:
FUNCTION:
API_ENDPOINT:
METHOD:
REQUEST_SCHEMA:
SUCCESS_REDIRECT:
ERROR_COMPONENT:
CURRENT_FAILURE:

There must be one canonical registration API and one canonical login API.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — CANONICAL API CONTRACT
==================================================

Create or confirm these production endpoints:

POST /api/members/register
POST /api/auth/login
POST /api/auth/logout
POST /api/auth/refresh
POST /api/auth/forgot-password
POST /api/auth/reset-password
POST /api/auth/resend-confirmation
GET  /api/registration/health
GET  /api/registration/status/:requestId
GET  /api/session
GET  /api/me

Optional role-specific onboarding endpoints:

POST /api/onboarding/investor
POST /api/onboarding/buyer
POST /api/onboarding/jv-deal
POST /api/onboarding/tokenized
POST /api/onboarding/broker
POST /api/onboarding/agent
POST /api/onboarding/land-owner

Do not create separate authentication users for each role.

One auth user may hold one or more roles.

==================================================
PHASE 3 — REQUEST SCHEMA
==================================================

Canonical registration request:

{
  "registrationRequestId": "uuid",
  "firstName": "string",
  "lastName": "string",
  "email": "normalized lowercase email",
  "phone": "E.164 phone",
  "country": "ISO country code",
  "zipCode": "string",
  "password": "string",
  "roles": [
    "member",
    "investor",
    "buyer",
    "jv_deals",
    "tokenized",
    "broker",
    "agent",
    "land_owner"
  ],
  "source": "landing|mobile|invest_modal|owner_invite",
  "dealId": "optional uuid",
  "opportunityId": "optional uuid",
  "investmentAmount": "optional number",
  "acceptedTerms": true,
  "acceptedPrivacy": true,
  "marketingConsent": false,
  "locale": "en-US"
}

Validate server-side:

- first name required
- last name required
- valid normalized email
- valid E.164 phone
- password minimum policy
- country valid
- zip code valid for selected country
- at least one allowed role
- terms accepted
- roles use allowlist only
- amount positive when supplied
- deal exists when dealId supplied
- opportunity exists when opportunityId supplied

Never trust role values from the client without validation.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — CANONICAL DATABASE MODEL
==================================================

Verify or create these canonical tables:

auth.users
profiles
members
user_roles
investors
buyers
jv_partners
tokenized_investors
brokers
agents
land_owners
landing_investments
registration_requests
registration_events
sessions_audit
auth_recovery_events

Required identity relationship:

auth.users.id
→ profiles.auth_user_id
→ members.auth_user_id
→ role-specific table.auth_user_id

Required constraints:

- profiles.auth_user_id UNIQUE
- members.auth_user_id UNIQUE
- members.normalized_email UNIQUE
- registration_requests.registration_request_id UNIQUE
- one role row per auth user per role
- no active member with NULL auth_user_id
- no orphan profile
- no orphan investor
- no orphan buyer
- no orphan JV partner
- no orphan tokenized investor

Use transactions or compensating rollback logic.

A successful API response is forbidden unless the canonical records exist.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — IDEMPOTENCY AND DUPLICATE PREVENTION
==================================================

The current “Submitting request…” flow must not create duplicates.

Required:

1. Generate `registrationRequestId` once on form open.
2. Reuse the same ID for retries.
3. Disable the button while a request is active.
4. Backend checks the request ID before creating anything.
5. Duplicate request returns the existing result.
6. Duplicate email returns EMAIL_EXISTS.
7. Duplicate phone returns PHONE_EXISTS only if phone uniqueness is required.
8. Network retry does not create another auth user.
9. Double-tap does not create another member.
10. Browser refresh can recover registration status.

Return:

registrationRequestId
authUserId
memberId
profileId
roleRecords
stage
finalStatus

==================================================
PHASE 6 — REGISTRATION STATE MACHINE
==================================================

Implement one explicit state machine:

IDLE
CONFIG_CHECK
HEALTH_CHECK
VALIDATING
SUBMITTING
AUTH_CREATING
PROFILE_CREATING
MEMBER_CREATING
ROLES_CREATING
ROLE_RECORDS_CREATING
EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
PHONE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
SESSION_CREATING
COMPLETED
RECOVERABLE_ERROR
BLOCKED
FAILED
RATE_LIMITED

Rules:

- no stage may run forever
- every stage has a timeout
- every error maps to a terminal or retryable state
- UI text must match the real stage
- restart resumes by request ID
- duplicate submissions return the existing stage
- no generic “service unavailable” without a trace ID

==================================================
PHASE 7 — FIX THE “STILL CONNECTING TO SERVER” FAILURE
==================================================

Audit the Create Free Account screen.

Check:

1. Production API base URL
2. Supabase URL
3. Supabase anon key
4. Runtime config injection
5. CloudFront-served config
6. CORS
7. TLS
8. DNS
9. `/api/registration/health`
10. Request timeout
11. AbortController
12. stale service worker
13. stale CloudFront HTML
14. stale JavaScript bundle
15. environment placeholder values
16. API route mismatch
17. incorrect port
18. mixed HTTP/HTTPS
19. wrong backend domain
20. config variable naming mismatch

Required health response:

HTTP 200

{
  "status": "healthy",
  "registrationAvailable": true,
  "authAvailable": true,
  "databaseAvailable": true,
  "serviceKeyLoaded": true,
  "supabaseProject": "<redacted-id>",
  "runtimeCommit": "<sha>",
  "timestamp": "<iso>"
}

Do not return secret values.

If health fails, show:

- exact endpoint
- HTTP status
- error code
- trace ID
- retry action

==================================================
PHASE 8 — FIX THE “SUBMITTING REQUEST…” HANG
==================================================

Audit the Investor Review screen.

Required behavior:

1. Button enters SUBMITTING.
2. Request timeout starts.
3. Backend responds with a request ID.
4. UI polls status only when the backend returned 202.
5. Polling interval is bounded.
6. Maximum polling duration is enforced.
7. Abort when modal closes.
8. Retry preserves entered data.
9. Success changes to COMPLETED.
10. Failure changes to RECOVERABLE_ERROR or FAILED.
11. Button is re-enabled after terminal failure.
12. No infinite spinner.
13. No duplicate submission.
14. No silent catch block.
15. Every failure shows trace ID.

Recommended timeouts:

- config check: 5 seconds
- health check: 5 seconds
- registration request: 15 seconds
- status poll: every 2 seconds
- maximum poll window: 60 seconds

After 60 seconds:

STATUS_CHECK_TIMEOUT
with Retry Status and Cancel controls.

==================================================
PHASE 9 — ROLE CREATION
==================================================

After the canonical member exists, create the selected role records.

MEMBER:
- member record
- default role = member
- onboarding_status

INVESTOR:
- investor profile
- accreditation status
- investment preferences
- investment range
- preferred markets
- KYC status

BUYER:
- buyer profile
- target ZIP codes
- budget range
- property preferences
- financing status

JV_DEALS:
- JV partner profile
- capital/construction/land role
- target projects
- contribution type
- verification status

TOKENIZED:
- tokenized investor profile
- eligibility
- investment limits
- jurisdiction
- KYC/AML state

BROKER:
- broker profile
- license fields
- service markets
- verification state

AGENT:
- agent profile
- brokerage
- license
- market coverage

LAND_OWNER:
- land-owner profile
- property/parcel references
- target transaction type

Role creation must be transactional or safely recoverable.

==================================================
PHASE 10 — RLS AND AUTHORIZATION
==================================================

Enable and test RLS.

Users may:

- read/update their own profile
- read/update their own member row
- read/update their own role-specific rows
- read their own submissions
- read allowed public opportunities

Users may not:

- assign themselves owner/admin
- read another member’s private data
- edit another investor
- edit another buyer
- modify approval/KYC fields reserved for staff
- access owner dashboards

Owner/admin may:

- review members
- review investors
- review buyers
- review JV partners
- review tokenized investors
- update verification states
- merge duplicates
- deactivate accounts
- audit registration events

Run unauthorized and cross-user tests.

==================================================
PHASE 11 — PASSWORD POLICY
==================================================

Use a strong enterprise policy without making normal registration impossible.

Required:

- minimum 12 characters
- allow password managers
- allow long passwords
- support at least 64 characters
- no trimming internal spaces
- trim accidental leading/trailing spaces only if explicitly documented
- reject common compromised passwords where supported
- strength indicator
- show/hide password
- confirm-password match
- no password in logs
- no password in analytics
- no password in local storage
- no plaintext password persistence

MFA:

- optional
- OFF by default
- configurable in Settings
- not required for ordinary member signup
- may be required later for dangerous owner actions

==================================================
PHASE 12 — SIGN-IN
==================================================

Canonical login request:

POST /api/auth/login

{
  "email": "normalized email",
  "password": "user password",
  "rememberMe": true
}

Required behavior:

- valid credentials → session
- wrong password → INVALID_CREDENTIALS
- unknown email → same public message as wrong password
- unconfirmed email → EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
- suspended account → ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED
- deleted account → ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE
- rate limit → HTTP 429 + Retry-After
- expired session → refresh or re-login
- no owner-role trust from client metadata alone

After login:

GET /api/me

Return canonical:

- auth user ID
- member ID
- profile
- roles
- permissions
- onboarding status
- verification states

==================================================
PHASE 13 — SESSION PERSISTENCE
==================================================

Test:

1. Login
2. Refresh browser
3. Close/reopen browser
4. Close/reopen APK
5. Background/foreground
6. Network off/on
7. Access-token expiry
8. Refresh-token rotation
9. Password change
10. Logout
11. Old-session rejection
12. Multiple-device sessions

Acceptance:

- no unexpected logout
- no endless refresh loop
- no fake local session
- no password stored
- expired session handled cleanly
- logout clears local session
- server rejects revoked token

==================================================
PHASE 14 — EMAIL AND PHONE VERIFICATION
==================================================

Check existing SMTP and SMS credentials first.

EMAIL:

- account-confirmation email
- resend confirmation
- forgot password
- reset password
- email-change confirmation
- IVX branding
- production redirect URL
- expired/reused-link rejection

PHONE:

- normalize to E.164
- send OTP
- verify OTP
- expiry
- retry limit
- resend cooldown
- wrong-code limit
- no phone enumeration

Do not mark email or phone verification PASS without real delivery.

==================================================
PHASE 15 — ERROR CONTRACT
==================================================

All registration endpoints must return a structured error:

{
  "ok": false,
  "code": "EMAIL_EXISTS",
  "message": "An account already exists for this email.",
  "stage": "AUTH_CREATING",
  "retryable": false,
  "traceId": "ivx-reg-...",
  "requestId": "uuid"
}

Required codes:

INVALID_EMAIL
INVALID_PHONE
WEAK_PASSWORD
PASSWORD_MISMATCH
TERMS_REQUIRED
INVALID_ROLE
EMAIL_EXISTS
PHONE_EXISTS
DEAL_NOT_FOUND
OPPORTUNITY_NOT_FOUND
AUTH_CREATE_FAILED
PROFILE_CREATE_FAILED
MEMBER_CREATE_FAILED
ROLE_CREATE_FAILED
EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
PHONE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
INVALID_CREDENTIALS
ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED
RATE_LIMITED
NETWORK_ERROR
REQUEST_TIMEOUT
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
CONFIG_ERROR
UNKNOWN_ERROR

Never expose database or secret details to the client.

==================================================
PHASE 16 — UI RELIABILITY
==================================================

For every signup/sign-in screen:

- preserve form values after retry
- preserve selected roles
- prevent duplicate taps
- support keyboard correctly
- support password managers
- support autofill
- scroll focused field into view
- no keyboard overlap
- no infinite loading
- no disabled button after failed request
- accessible labels
- readable errors
- progress indicator tied to actual stage
- success confirmation
- trace ID on support errors
- Back and Close work safely

Role selector must be single-select or multi-select according to the business rule.
Do not allow contradictory role behavior across screens.

==================================================
PHASE 17 — RATE LIMITS AND ABUSE PROTECTION
==================================================

Verify rate limits on:

- signup
- login
- forgot password
- resend confirmation
- OTP send
- OTP verify
- status polling

Required:

- HTTP 429
- Retry-After
- per-IP protection
- per-account protection
- no global lockout
- safe owner/admin exception only if intentionally designed
- CAPTCHA or challenge only after suspicious activity
- no account enumeration

==================================================
PHASE 18 — OBSERVABILITY
==================================================

Log structured registration events:

REGISTRATION_STARTED
CONFIG_CHECKED
HEALTH_CHECKED
VALIDATION_FAILED
AUTH_CREATED
PROFILE_CREATED
MEMBER_CREATED
ROLE_ASSIGNED
ROLE_RECORD_CREATED
EMAIL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
PHONE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
SESSION_CREATED
REGISTRATION_COMPLETED
REGISTRATION_FAILED
LOGIN_SUCCEEDED
LOGIN_FAILED
RECOVERY_REQUESTED
PASSWORD_RESET_COMPLETED

Each event must include:

- request ID
- trace ID
- auth user ID when available
- member ID when available
- role
- stage
- duration
- status
- error code
- source
- timestamp

Never log passwords, tokens, OTPs, or secret keys.

==================================================
PHASE 19 — DATABASE INTEGRITY QA
==================================================

After each test signup verify:

- exactly one auth user
- exactly one profile
- exactly one member
- correct user_roles rows
- correct role-specific records
- no orphan rows
- no NULL auth_user_id
- normalized email stored
- normalized phone stored
- request ID stored
- source stored
- deal/opportunity stored where applicable

Test each role independently:

1. member
2. investor
3. buyer
4. jv_deals
5. tokenized
6. broker
7. agent
8. land_owner

Then test approved multi-role combinations.

==================================================
PHASE 20 — COMPLETE QA MATRIX
==================================================

Run on:

- iPhone Safari
- Samsung Browser
- Android Chrome
- desktop Chrome
- desktop Safari
- production APK

Test cases:

1. New member signup

3. New buyer signup
4. New JV partner signup

6. New broker signup

11. Invalid email

13. Weak password
14. Password mismatch

16. No role selected

18. Slow network
19. Offline before submit
20. Network loss during submit
21. Backend timeout

23. Member succeeds but role insert fails
24. Browser refresh mid-submit
25. Modal close mid-submit
26. Correct login
27. Wrong password
28. Unconfirmed email
29. Logout/login
30. Restart/session persistence
31. Forgot password
32. Password reset
33. Resend confirmation
34. Rate limit
35. Role authorization

Return PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN per platform and scenario.

==================================================
PHASE 21 — LIVE CANARY ACCOUNTS
==================================================

Create one controlled canary account per role using safe test addresses.

For each canary return:

ROLE:
REQUEST_ID:
TRACE_ID:
AUTH_USER_ID:
PROFILE_ID:
MEMBER_ID:
ROLE_RECORD_ID:
HTTP_STATUS:
FINAL_STAGE:
FINAL_STATUS:
LOGIN_RESULT:
SESSION_RESULT:
DATABASE_RESULT:

Delete or clearly mark canary records after testing.

==================================================
PHASE 22 — DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After fixes:

1. Run targeted tests.
2. Run full registration tests.
3. Run authentication tests.
4. Run RLS tests.
5. Run TypeScript.
6. Run lint.
7. Run security scan.
8. Commit.
9. Deploy backend.
10. Upload landing changes.
11. Invalidate CloudFront.
12. Build new APK if mobile files changed.
13. Verify GitHub HEAD equals runtime SHA.
14. Verify live JavaScript asset hash.
15. Verify APK source SHA.

Owner approvals:

CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE
CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY
CONFIRM_IVX_CLOUDFRONT_INVALIDATION
CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD

==================================================
PHASE 23 — REQUIRED LIVE PROOF
==================================================

Do not mark PASS without:

- GitHub commit SHA
- Render deploy ID
- Render runtime SHA
- GitHub/runtime match
- landing ETag
- CloudFront invalidation ID
- API health HTTP 200
- registration health HTTP 200
- live signup HTTP response
- database row IDs
- successful live login
- successful session restore
- screenshots
- trace IDs
- timestamps
- APK version if mobile changed

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

Do not certify until:

[ ] “Still connecting to server” is eliminated.
[ ] “Submitting request…” cannot hang indefinitely.
[ ] All forms use the canonical API.
[ ] All roles create canonical records.
[ ] Duplicate submission creates no duplicates.
[ ] Every signup creates auth + profile + member + roles.
[ ] Every role-specific table is correctly populated.
[ ] Login works.
[ ] Logout works.
[ ] Session persistence works.
[ ] Refresh-token rotation works.
[ ] Email confirmation works or is honestly blocked by verified SMTP absence.
[ ] Password reset works or is honestly blocked by verified SMTP absence.
[ ] Phone verification works or is honestly blocked by verified SMS absence.
[ ] RLS prevents cross-user access.
[ ] Owner routes reject normal members.
[ ] Rate limiting returns 429.
[ ] No infinite spinner exists.
[ ] No generic error without trace ID exists.
[ ] Web and APK are tested.
[ ] GitHub/runtime parity is true.
[ ] Database integrity is verified.
[ ] Live canary tests pass.
